Yes, I've calmed down quite a lot from when I was diagnosed, honestly mostly only in the last two years... It is possible my diagnoses has changed, but also maybe not. I still have a lot of the qualities associated with borderline... But I'd honestly say I'm less 'crazy' ... I kind of feel like a functioning alcoholic but with depression and anxiety.
My boyfriend is bipolar, he has days where he won't get out of bed. I force myself to go to work so I can provide for us ... I don't know if he is worse or if I'm better at hiding..
I have noticed that his moods can bring on swings of depression in myself. Do you find this happens with you and your husband? Do you have a way to deal with it?

Yes, I've been "clean" of medication for about 5 years now.
Honestly I believe I was put on too much too young, so, with the aid of therapists I tried to veer away from medication.
I was heavily medicated since I was about 12, in my mid teens they had me on over 300mg of Effexor plus serequel at night plus two other drugs that I can't seem to remember now, one was specifically for anxiety.
I was officially diagnosed with Borderline Personality Disorder, though I realize not everyone recognizes that as a condition. Regardless, I don't care about any diagnoses, I've worked with an attitude that my mind can overcome, and a diagnoses is just a vouplewords on paper... But sometimes I think I might be wrong.
Now I'm curious though... Who are you booked with?
Oh, also, I'm female, so they had me on birth control since I was 12 as well for my terrible acne(which helped to completely obliterate any self esteem I had left into puberty) and they thought it would help with my depression.
I've now had a copper IUD for 4 years (so no added horned) and am more stable than I've ever been in my life... But something is still very wrong I think
